$comment: Taxonomy registry for TopTaco content. One taxonomy groups like things; a term is a value inside it. The site and the blog publisher read this file, so adding a project means adding one string here and tagging content with data-taxonomy.

project.label: Internal Projects
project.description: Which TopTaco project a piece of content belongs to. Content without a project term is company-wide.
